headline: Superintendent finalist Thomas Welch answered questions on budgeting, equity, family engagement, and student support during an interview.
summary: Dr. Thomas Welch answered questions from members about budgeting, family partnerships, and support for students facing barriers. He also described what Salem's schools should look like in ten years.
